name: StatTile
title: StatTile
summary: A metric tile with one big number, a short label, an optional up or down change and an optional sparkline, on light or dark.
whenToUse: Use for ministry reach on landing pages (languages, stations, partners) and for KPI rows in staff dashboards.
Use four tiles in a row on desktop, two on tablet, one or two on mobile.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a single sentence-sized fact inside body copy; write it in the sentence.
Do not use when the number cannot be sourced; say "sample" until it is.

props.name: value
props.description: The big number, abbreviated if large (1.2M).

props.name: label
props.description: Short label, three or four words.

props.name: delta
props.description: Optional change since a previous period.

props.name: spark
props.description: Optional sparkline series (at least two numbers). Decorative.

props.name: sparkFlat
props.description: Grey sparkline for a flat or falling series.

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark tile: wraps the tile in the `.dp-dk` panel. Do not mix light and dark tiles in one row.

props.name: sample
props.description: Mark the figure as a sample (invented, for mock-ups) with `.dp-sample`.

variantNotes: Dark: inside `.dp-dk` (black panel with the blue/gold glow) or `.sec-ink`; tile goes to 4% white with a 14% white border.
Delta up: `.dp-delta-up` (`--success`, on dark `--success-on-dark`). Down: `.dp-delta-down` (`--error`, on dark `--error-on-dark`).
Sparkline: `.dp-spark` in `--horizon-blue` (on dark `--blue-on-dark`); `.dp-spark-flat` grey for flat or falling series.
Without delta or sparkline: number and label only.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Number: 44px, weight 600, tracking -0.03em, tabular figures. Label: 15px `--gray-700`.
Use vertical arrows only (↑ ↓). The ↗ arrow is reserved for links to another page.
Always give the period after the delta ("this quarter", "vs last year").
Sparkline is 88×32, 2px stroke, last point marked with a 3px dot. No axes, no labels.
Keep tiles in a row the same height; do not mix light and dark tiles in one row.
Mark invented figures as samples with `.dp-sample` or in the label.

accessibility: The sparkline is decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`); the delta text carries the meaning.
Do not rely on green or red alone: the arrow and the sign (+ / −) state direction.
Write the delta so it reads well aloud: "up 3 this quarter". Add a `.dp-vh` phrase if the visual is terse.
Text contrast meets AA on both themes with the token colours above.
content: Lead with what matters to people: "500+ Bible languages", "38 HD Radio stations".
Keep labels to three or four words. Abbreviate large numbers (1.2M), not small ones.
Only "500+ languages" is an ISM public figure; the rest in the preview are samples.

html:
38 HD Radio stations
+3 this quarter
…tiles…
